desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2019 in Orchid Grove. Split-bedroom plan with high ceilings, open kitchen and family room; the kitchen has dark wood cabinetry, granite counters, stainless appliances, a pantry and an island with breakfast bar. Sliding doors from the family room to a covered rear lanai. Carpet and luxury vinyl. Walk-in closet in the primary; primary bedroom on the main floor.
notes: Seller mentions an assumable mortgage; terms are not in the listing and would need to be requested.
The seller's preferred lender offers 0.75% of the loan toward rate buydown or closing costs plus a $600 appraisal credit, conditional on using that lender.
Current owner has homestead, so the 2025 tax bill of $6,968 will be reassessed; CDD of $2,247 per year on top of the HOA.
Association approval is required for leases. $5,000 minimum deposit; 3-hour notice for showings.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2021 at the end of a dead-end street in Orchid Terrace, Haines City. Open plan with granite counters in the kitchen and a separate dining area; split bedrooms, walk-in closet in the primary suite. Carpet and ceramic tile. Washer and dryer included. Patio at the rear. Smallest living area of the three-bedroom homes in this group at 1,292 sf.
notes: Price reduced from $299,900 to $274,900 over 111 days on market.
The listing agent is related to the sellers. Owner occupied; showings scheduled through the agent with 2 hours' notice.
The 2025 tax bill of $6,673 includes a CDD assessment of about $3,113; the owner has homestead, so the bill will be reassessed after purchase.
No truck, RV or motorcycle parking in the community. One bedroom photo is virtually staged.

desc: Single-story block home built in 2003 in Silver Palms, a small neighborhood off US-27. Four bedrooms and three full baths in 1,846 sf, the largest home in this group. New roof in 2023 and new A/C in 2022. Living and dining combination, primary bedroom on the main floor, carpet and tile. Washer and dryer included. No CDD.
notes: Listed at $305,000, above the $300,000 ceiling of the previous search; reduced from $322,000 over 114 days.
All 11 photos are virtually staged.
Current owner has homestead, so the 2025 tax bill of $4,358 will be reassessed after purchase.
Financing terms are not stated in the listing.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2016 in Highland Meadows, on the Haines City side of the Davenport line. Open plan with wood-look flooring in the main areas, kitchen with granite counters, updated backsplash, black appliances and breakfast bar. Smart-home features. Walk-in closet; carpet in the bedrooms. Range and refrigerator included; no dishwasher or microwave listed.
notes: Lowest HOA of the group at $89 per year, with a CDD of $1,354 per year on top.
Minimum lease of 1 to 7 days per the listing: short-term rental appears permitted, to be confirmed with the HOA.
Current owner has homestead, so the 2025 tax bill of $4,828 will be reassessed after purchase.
Vacant. $3,000 minimum escrow deposit.

desc: Single-story block home built in 2018 on a 6,334 sf corner lot in Highland Meadows, Haines City. Living and dining combination, carpet and ceramic tile. Washer, dryer and all kitchen appliances included. Solar panels are included in the sale price.
notes: Solar panels are included in the price per the listing; whether they are owned outright or carry a loan is not stated and must be confirmed.
No pets allowed per the listing.
Price reduced from $277,000 to $269,577 over 56 days. The listing asks for a 10% escrow deposit.
Current owner has homestead, so the 2025 tax bill of $4,145 will be reassessed; CDD of $1,598 per year.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2009 in the gated Park Ridge community, on a 6,604 sf lot. Living area of 2,092 sf, the largest of the three-bedroom homes in this group. Living and dining combination, primary bedroom on the main floor, laminate and tile floors. No CDD. The listing carries no written description.
notes: Seller is Opendoor: offers go through opendoor.com, answered by the next business day. Seller gives credit in lieu of repairs; a 100-day home warranty is included.
FHA financing only on contracts dated January 5, 2027 or later, because of the 90-day flip rule. Cash, conventional and VA are open now.
HOA of $385 per quarter, the highest in this group. Association approval required for leases.
No homestead on the 2025 tax bill of $3,574. Vacant; access code through ShowingTime.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2005 on a fenced 6,299 sf lot in Heather Hill. Newer roof per the listing. Open plan with vaulted ceilings, built-in shelving, primary bedroom on the main floor with walk-in closet. Carpet, ceramic tile, laminate and wood floors. Covered rear patio with fruit trees. Gas water heater. Washer and dryer included. No CDD.
notes: The seller never occupied the home, so there is no seller's property disclosure.
Tax figure in the MLS is $4,759 for tax year 2026, no homestead.
Offers on the As-Is contract with pre-qualification or proof of funds, flood disclosure and HOA rider.
Vacant. 16 photos.

desc: Single-story stucco home built in 2003 on a 7,362 sf lot in Winfield Heights, close to the new Walmart and Sam's Club. Recently installed shingle roof. Eat-in kitchen with laminate counters; carpet and linoleum floors. Heat pump. Dishwasher, dryer, range and refrigerator included. No CDD. Smallest home of the group at 1,233 sf.
notes: The MLS lists a garage but zero garage spaces and not attached; confirm on site.
Current owner has homestead and the 2025 tax bill is $968, so the bill will rise substantially after purchase (estimate below).
Interior finishes are original: laminate counters, linoleum. Budget for updates.
Owner occupied; showings through ShowingTime. 17 photos.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2022 in Bella Vita, on a 4,600 sf lot. Split-bedroom plan, great room with sliding doors to a rear lanai, kitchen with stainless appliances and island. Ceramic tile throughout. Washer and dryer included. HUD-owned.
notes: HUD home (case 098-129800): at this stage only owner-occupant buyers, nonprofits and government agencies may bid. Investors are excluded until HUD opens the bid period. Offers go through hudhomestore.gov.
Sold strictly as is: no repairs, no credits. Utilities are off; the buyer must request activation for inspections through the preservation company.
2025 tax bill of $7,465 with no homestead, plus a CDD of $2,217 per year. The HOA is $86.13 per month.
Buyer selects the title company. Realtor must accompany all visits.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 1999 in High Vista, a gated 55+ community inside Ridgewood Lakes with 24-hour guard. New HVAC and water heater in 2024, new quartz counters in kitchen and primary bath in 2024. Split-bedroom plan with vaulted ceiling and tray ceilings, LVP in the main areas, tile in baths, carpet in bedrooms. French doors to a screened rear lanai. Extended 20×22 garage. HOA covers guard, pool, internet, grounds and private roads; private clubhouse 0.3 miles away.
notes: High Vista is a 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older, and the association approves buyers.
Two HOAs and three HOA disclosures; $230 per month combined per the listing.
Sold as is with no disclosures. Cash or conventional only. $5,000 deposit financed, $10,000 cash; 7-day inspection, 30-day loan approval.
Current owner has homestead and the 2025 tax bill is $1,360, so taxes will be reassessed after purchase.

pets: Cats and dogs OK, number limit
desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2019 in Del Webb Orlando, a gated 55+ community inside Ridgewood Lakes with 24-hour guard. Two bedrooms plus a den, 1,464 sf. Open plan with ceramic tile throughout, kitchen with granite island, gas cooktop, solid wood cabinets, walk-in pantry and raised dishwasher. Walk-in closet, dual sinks in the primary bath. Extended screened and enclosed rear lanai, vinyl fence, irrigation. Gas water heater, gas dryer hookup.
notes: Del Webb Orlando is a 55+ community; the age rule applies to the resident.
Two bedrooms plus a den, not a three-bedroom.
HOA of $333 per month. Repairs to the primary shower and interior touch-ups are pending per the listing agent.
No homestead on the 2025 tax bill of $5,024. Several photos are virtually staged. Financing terms not stated.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 1997 in Wellington, ZIP 33897, less than 20 minutes from Disney per the listing. Two bedrooms and two baths in 1,025 sf, plus a Florida room the listing suggests could serve as a third bedroom. Brand new roof installed October 2026; A/C from 2024. Open plan with high ceilings, eat-in kitchen, laminate and tile. Cabana and oversized fenced backyard on a 6,534 sf lot. Original owners.
notes: Two bedrooms, 1,025 sf: the smallest home in the group. The Florida room is not a bedroom in the MLS count.
Minimum lease of one week per the listing: short-term rental appears permitted, to be confirmed with the HOA.
Price reduced from $280,000 to $265,000 in 31 days. Current owner has homestead and the 2025 tax bill is $1,112, so taxes will be reassessed.
As-Is contract with proof of funds or pre-approval.

desc: Single-story stucco home built in 1994 on a 15,050 sf lot in Bentley Oaks, ZIP 33896: at 0.35 acre, by far the largest lot in the group. Split-bedroom plan with vaulted ceilings, ceramic tile through most of the home, kitchen with stainless appliances and pass-through to the living area. Sliding doors to the backyard. Mature shade tree at the front. No CDD.
notes: Roof age is unknown per the listing agent; water heater 6 years, HVAC 8 years. An inspection and roof certification will matter for insurance.
Seller is an investor who never occupied the home; allow 2 business days for a response. No homestead on the 2025 tax bill of $3,732.
Price reduced from $299,900 to $295,000 over 49 days.
Offers on the As-Is contract with all MLS disclosures; the property may be under video and audio surveillance.

desc: Single-story block and stucco home built in 2003 in High Vista, a gated 55+ community inside Ridgewood Lakes with 24-hour guard. Two bedrooms and two baths in 1,395 sf, with an office area. Split plan, tray ceiling and two walk-in closets in the primary, eat-in kitchen, tile in the great room and south-facing lanai, carpet in bedrooms. HOA covers guard, cable, internet, grounds, private roads and recreation. The listing carries no written description.
notes: High Vista is a 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older, and the association approves buyers.
Two bedrooms, not three. Lowest price in the group at $245,000.
Two HOAs and three HOA disclosures; $230 per month combined. Cash or conventional only. $5,000 deposit financed, $10,000 cash.
Sold as is. No homestead on the 2025 tax bill of $3,766. Many photos are virtually staged; 68 days on market.
